playingAs: 시공간 붕괴 is a potent escape tool, but it can also be quite powerful when used offensively. Don't underestimate its damage potential.
If you can proc Z 드라이브 공진 on an enemy champion, it's worth taking risks to do so. The bonus Z-Drive Resonance 2 movement speed makes it easy to escape.
시간 도약's dash is a great tool for setting up Ekko's other abilities. Use it to get double hits with 시간의 톱니바퀴 or get into position to detonate 평행 시간 교차.
playingAgainst: Ekko is significantly weaker when his 시공간 붕괴 is down. Watch for the trail he leaves behind to determine if 시공간 붕괴 is available.
Ekko's 평행 시간 교차 takes 3 seconds to arm. Watch for the image he creates on cast and try to guess where the zone was placed.
The second hit of 시간의 톱니바퀴 does more damage than the first; try to avoid it.
Like many other assassins, Ekko is vulnerable to crowd control. Snaring or stunning Ekko before he can deal heavy damage can heavily cripple his potential in teamfights.
After using Phase Dive, Ekko is even more vulnerable to heavy CC and huge bursts. This situation will likely cause most Ekko players to burn Chronobreak just to survive the incoming burst damage.
While Ekko is a threat on his own, His kit is to primarily for 1v1 dueling and start fights. Dodging Timewinder, or Parallel Convergence can prevent Ekko from closing in on you easily.
Baiting Ekko in using his Parallel Convergence into heavy ambushes can be a good strategy. His stun and shield is on a long cooldown and your team can close up on him and kill him.

When Ekko is retreating with low health and his hologram is following him, be wary. It means his Chronobreak is available and he can instantly turn the fight around with its healing and heavy magic damage.

When your team is chasing a low health Ekko, If you notice Chronobreak is ready, launch skillshots onto his hologram. Ekko players tend to use Chronobreak to attempt to turn the tables rather than run away. It's better if it is a heavy CC. Your team can catch up and kill him.

notes: Ekko is mainly played as a mobile burst assassin, with high AP and CDR, to delete squishes while remaining a slippery nuisance. But due to his 'sticky' kit, he can also be played as a "tanky mage", combining items like Rod of Ages, Iceborn Gauntlet and Spirit Visage.

All of his skills have great synergy with themselves. 시간의 톱니바퀴+평행 시간 교차 or 평행 시간 교차+시간의 톱니바퀴 to slow/stun the enemy and land the latter perfectly, 시간 도약+평행 시간 교차 to get to the sphere faster, 시공간 붕괴+평행 시간 교차 for the AoE stun and damage etc.
It is possible to proc his Z 드라이브 공진 on every damaging spell. So running and using Q for a double stack and then 시공간 붕괴 back on the target is a risky but rewarding way to one-shot most champions.
시간의 톱니바퀴 is a really good farming tool as it has a low cooldown and decent damage. Be careful though as spamming it will drain your mana and may also ruin the minion wave without enough AP.

playingAs: Soraka is a powerful ally in battle, using her strong healing to keep the party moving forward.

playingAgainst: Focus on attacking Soraka when she ever ventures to the frontline to heal her allies.
Take advantage of Soraka long cooldown on 별의 균형 if she uses it to harass.
It's easier to focus Soraka than the ally she is healing.

notes: Use 구원 to weave in and out of danger and determine which ally needs healing. Be careful not to lead yourself into danger, as some allies may not be able to be saved.
Salvation indicator, which appears on allies below 40% maximum health, also indicates when they will receive the 50% increased heal from 기원.
구원 only gives bonus movement speed when approaching low-health allies in range. Thus, it might even be beneficial to leave allies low just long enough to escape danger.

Sometimes, it may be unnecessary to use 별부름 if Soraka is at full health, and if 은하의 마력 is maxed first instead, the damage in early laning may be negligible. In this case, it may better to conserve your mana for more appropriate times.
별부름 provides vision of unwarded brush for a brief period. Use this to check bushes rather than warding them or directly facechecking, as this can help prevent unwanted deaths.

Leveling 은하의 마력 at level 1 is desirable if you wish to give your a jungler a "perfect" leash in the support role, need to level it on-point in the case of early jungle invades, and/or seek to play passive in lane. Maxing it first will dramatically buff the heal on an ally.

Soraka should be able to heal her jungler once during the leash, step out of experience range when her jungler Smite's the buff, and then heal her jungler a second time while heading to lane with her ADC in a fashionable time frame.
Despite its health cost, 은하의 마력 has a relatively low mana cost. As such, in a support role in lane, Soraka can remain relevant with only a couple points of extra mana regeneration.
Reserving her 은하의 마력 until after she has hit enemy champions with 별부름 will pass the health regeneration onto her target ally and maximizes the ratio of health and mana cost to heal amount.
Casting 은하의 마력 many times over a short period can drain a large portion of Soraka health. Be mindful of positioning in extended trades.
Once both 별부름 and 은하의 마력 are leveled at least once, Soraka should be seeking to land 별부름s to regain some or all of the health that is lost from casting 은하의 마력.
If Soraka fails to land enough sufficient Starcall, it may be necessary to invest in some alternative health restoration methods through itemization, including health regeneration and consumables.
은하의 마력 can be a powerful, though risky, lane control tool if used effectively.
별의 균형 is rarely leveled first and is typically the last ability to be maxed.
Due to Equinox instantaneous cast time, it can be used to swiftly interrupt channeled abilities, such as Death Lotus or Monsoon.

When escaping from a dangerous situation, lead the path of your enemy and cast 별의 균형 where they would be rooted.
While 별의 균형 never guarantees a root if any enemy champion simply walks over its entire radius, the slow from 별부름 will make the root more likely to occur.
별의 균형 cannot deal damage to lane minions or neutral monsters.
Use 기원 in the early laning phase to make an impact on allied lanes across the map.
If you are sure only a single ally will die and that a 기원 will not be able to save them, it may be wise to conserve it for a more appropriate use.

Pick your target before the fight. Focusing all of Talon's abilities on one target can be very rewarding, but splitting them up between many may leave you helpless.

Talon tends to lose his influence in the late game, as he can easily risk getting killed while diving in teamfights. Prolonged games can be a bane for him.

Be mindful of enemy positioning and vision. They could make or break your power with Assassin's Path.
Warding the enemy jungle can help with pinpointing where the enemy jungler is or where you can ambush unsuspecting targets.

playingAs: Tristana's 정조준 allows her to fire at a safe distance, exploit this as much as possible.

Tristanahas great power when pushing her lane. If your enemy isn't nearby, she can exploit this by shoving towards the tower to take it out.

Tristana's cooldowns are very long, especially in the early game where she doesn't have a lot of power. Therefore, you should play the lane safe and focus on farming towards items and poking the enemy down to prevent their engages.
playingAgainst: Tristana will naturally push lane with 폭발 화약, ambush her if she attempts to siege.
Tristana becomes problematic by the time she reaches her full build, it is strongly suggested to end the game before that occurs.
폭발 화약 helps Tristana farm out of her weak early game. Pushing the lane towards her tower will make farming incredibly challenging with this ability.
Tristana can inflict massive damage in a team-fight. Forcing her to escape will prevent her from decimating your team.
Stand away from your minions in lane to avoid collateral damage from 폭발 화약.
Try to not engage Tristana when she can easily escape with her 로켓 점프 and 대구경 탄환 off cooldown. The exception is when you can hold her in place with crowd control long enough to kill her.

Tristana mainly deals damage from her auto-attacks. Randuin's Omen and Frozen Heart are good items to counter build against her, since it will greatly reduce her DPS.
If Tristana is building AP, be very cautious and ward well as she may jump out of nowhere and one-shot you easily. Also, missing calls can prevent a lot of her potential ganks.

In team fights, do not leave any squishy teammates in the front and prepare some CC for her all-in. Be sure to retreat if your team is weakened, because the cooldown of 로켓 점프 resets whenever she gets a Takedown.
